title: Prompt-Pay Discount on Patient Invoices & Statements
content:
The prompt-pay discount on Patient Invoices & Statements applies only to billing classes whose prompt-pay discount rate is above 0.

## The rule

The discount is taken when the patient pays the whole remaining balance, less the discount, in one payment made no later than the billing class's prompt-pay window, in calendar days, after the first statement date. The first statement date is day 0 and the last day of the window is included.

The discount equals the class's prompt-pay discount rate, taken as a percentage of the balance due at the moment of payment, rounded to the cent. It is posted as an adjustment of the prompt-pay discount type together with the payment.

The discount is not given on a balance carried on a payment plan, on an invoice in collections, or on a part payment. It is applied after any financial-assistance adjustment already posted, never before; where such an adjustment has been posted, the discount is given only when the assistance tier of the Patient Financial Assistance Program that funded it allows a prompt-pay discount on the balance left after the assistance discount. Classes that carry payer cost share never receive it.

## Conditions at a glance

| Condition | Required for the discount |
|---|---|
| Class prompt-pay discount rate above 0 | Yes |
| Class carries payer cost share | Must not |
| One payment of the whole remaining balance less the discount | Yes |
| Payment no later than the last day of the window | Yes |
| Balance carried on a payment plan | Must not |
| Invoice in collections | Must not |
| Financial-assistance adjustment already posted | Then the funding tier must allow the discount on the balance left after it |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

**Plain balance.** Balance due 236.47; hypothetical class rate 15 percent. Fifteen percent of 236.47 is 35.4705, which rounds to 35.47. The patient pays 236.47 less 35.47, that is 201.00, in one payment within the window; a prompt-pay discount adjustment of 35.47 is posted together with the payment of 201.00, and the balance due becomes 0.00.

**After financial assistance.** Original balance 400.00; a financial-assistance adjustment of 200.00 is already posted, leaving 200.00 due; hypothetical class rate 10 percent. If the funding assistance tier allows the discount on the balance left after the assistance discount, the discount is 10 percent of 200.00, that is 20.00, and the single payment is 180.00. If that tier does not allow it, no prompt-pay discount is given and the full 200.00 remains due.

**Part payment.** On the 236.47 balance, a payment of 100.00 is a part payment and earns no discount.

## The window (hypothetical first statement date, hypothetical 30-day window)

| Payment date | Day of the count | Within the window |
|---|---|---|
| 3 March 2026 (first statement date) | day 0 | yes |
| 2 April 2026 | day 30, the last day | yes |
| 3 April 2026 | day 31 | no |
